title: Run
description: One executor dispatch (one codex/claude invocation against a brief). Records the dispatch parameters + trace pointers; does NOT duplicate trace contents (which live in .agent-trace/codex-<ts>.{jsonl,last,stderr}).

model.description: PM-facing alias OR wire model id. Aliases resolved via share/model-aliases.tsv.

brief_file.description: Absolute path to the brief markdown file (typically /tmp/brief-<slug>-XXXXXX.md).

trace_path.description: Absolute path to .agent-trace/codex-<ts>.jsonl. Run row does NOT include trace contents.
